name: playwright-browser-bridge
description: Singleton, loopback-only Playwright MCP companion for durable review-browser access.

interface.shortDescription: Run the dedicated Post Office review browser.
interface.longDescription: A Post Office companion that owns one pinned Playwright MCP service and a dedicated persistent Chrome profile. Review callers use the narrow automatic-review interface and never receive raw browser or CDP authority.
defaultPrompt: Check the Post Office browser bridge.
